title: Discs Over Traced Figure
description: Vertical column of compact discs descends a yellow-washed central axis over a white ground bearing ink-traced female figure outlines. Two photographic eye fragments are embedded at chest level, alongside a metallic spray-can element and scattered ink loops.
composition: vertical disc column over traced figure
dimensions_source: CD reference: 5 of the discs in the vertical column, identical radius (170.8px native), 0% spread, spread across nearly the full canvas height. Visually confirmed real, unobscured discs. Estimated 2026-08-03.
